newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - British Airways up in N.Y.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - British Airways up in N.Y.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc rose in New York on Monday amid signs Britain would approve an alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines.

American Depositary Receipts rebounded with the larger markets after dropping Friday on remarks by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan. Some analysts interpreted them as warning of higher interest rates to cool down equity markets.

Val Kosmider, head of international equity trading at Schroder Wertheim, said that Greenspan had warned markets "you shouldn't have your face too close to the windshield for fear of putting on the brakes."
He added that Monday was "the big bounce. The nervousness has been blown away."

British Airways rose 3-1/4 to 98-5/8 after the British government said on Friday that it would clear a planned alliance with American if the carriers sold 168 landing slots at London's Heathrow airport. The UK conditions were not as tough as some observers had expected.
European Union sources said on Monday the European Commission still had doubts about whether to clear the alliance.
